svg.aria-label: The modes of the researcher skill, in the order of a project. /researcher novelty: The closest prior work on each claim, a verdict per claim, a page in notes/ | /researcher idea: The research questions and claims, in rounds of the interview; novelty run between the rounds | Frame: The questions, the limits, the cluster's facts and the dataset | Build: Each piece of code by a builder, checked by a reviewer | Baseline: The baseline's jobs through the scheduler | Experiments: Each campaign's jobs through the scheduler | Compare: Each result against the baseline, with a diagnosis | Consolidate: run_all.sh in a clean copy, the record of the experiments | /researcher manuscript: Stage 2: the writing, /paper full; Stage 2.5: the first integrity check; Stage 3: the review, /paper-review-panel; Stage 4: the revision, /paper revision; Stages 3' and 4': the re-review and the re-revision; Stage 4.5: the final integrity check | /researcher revision: The referee comments split into results and text comments; A campaign of the research stages for each results comment; /paper revision with the new results, then the checks of manuscript | README.md: what each mode that reads or writes it keeps there: idea: the research questions and claims; research and research adopt: the working state a new session resumes from, and the results; full: the modes it runs, in order, in ## Next; revision, and manuscript when the README holds ## Papers: each paper and the results it reports | /researcher readme, beside them: The README and the code README drafted for a newcomer, written after you approve the drafts.
